project_info.theme: Eco-refill shampoo demonstration in a lush garden setting
project_info.color_palette: Deep Green, Botanical Lime, Warm Gold, Cream White

main_subject.detail: A product demo showing Cocoon pomelo shampoo being poured from a dark green eco-refill pouch into a standing dark green shampoo bottle, set on a wet wooden surface beside sparkling water spray and dense tropical plants.
main_subject.style: Premium outdoor beauty product demonstration, realistic refill-use scenario, eco-luxury botanical photography

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes the refill badge '78% GIẢM NHỰA SO VỚI DẠNG CHAI' and the main label 'Dầu gội bưởi / Pomelo shampoo'.
items: Top Left: Vertical sparkling water streaks catching sunlight like a shower or sprinkler.
Top Right: Two hands holding and squeezing a dark green refill pouch downward toward the bottle opening.
Bottom Left: Full-size dark green pomelo shampoo bottle standing upright on a wet wooden ledge with label facing front.
Bottom Right: Soft-focus fern leaves and water droplets across a lush tropical background.
Center/Background: A white stream of shampoo pouring cleanly from the refill pouch into the open bottle neck.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Sparkling water highlights, glossy wet surfaces, fresh botanical humidity, crisp product shine

Background is a lush tropical garden with sparkling water spray and a wet wooden surface. Surrounding elements: hands holding the refill pouch, visible label text 'Dầu gội bưởi / Pomelo shampoo', the refill badge '78% GIẢM NHỰA SO VỚI DẠNG CHAI', and fresh green foliage. Keep the real pouring action, outdoor humidity feel, and exact refill-use demonstration. Technical style: high fidelity outdoor product photography, bright outdoor sunlight, sparkling water highlights and glossy wet surfaces, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
